description: Do one thing on the screen, as the person. Numbers refer to the latest screen you were shown — only what is in view; scroll to see more. It happens after the pause a real person would take on that screen, then you get the new screen — or a survey card, or the end of the visit.

done.description: For leave: true if you got what you came for

index.description: Number of the thing to click, type into, hover over or drag. For scroll/scroll_up, the number of a part of the screen that scrolls on its own (or of something inside it) — or -1 to scroll the page. -1 otherwise

text.description: For type: what you type (in the language of the site), or the option/value to choose in a dropdown, slider or date box. For press: the key (Escape, Tab, Enter, ArrowDown…). For drag without `to`: the direction (left, right, up, down) or the words written on the place to drop it

times.description: For scroll, scroll_up, click or press: how many times in a row, quickly (scrolling down while skimming, clicking again because nothing happened, pressing an arrow key a few times). Default 1

to.description: For drag: the number of the thing to drop it onto; -1 to drag in the direction given in text

why.description: One short sentence in English: what you are doing and why, as this person

name: act
